name: TNKE Smart Problem Tagging — 16 Categories + Action Plan Mockup

metadata.source: Curated F-59 reference + QGIS tags validated against TNKE block polygons
metadata.reference_preservation: Original F-59 issue, severity, dates, tag_id and coordinates unchanged. Numeric id de-duplicated with original_id stored.
metadata.scenario: South 30% (north-south latitude span) has dominant but nonexclusive underpruning in nearly all QGIS-covered blocks.
metadata.location_note: QGIS point coordinates unchanged; areas outside named polygons removed; QGIS F-59 records excluded.
metadata.source_note: Data simulated for UI demonstration; not real observations.
metadata.unit_note: Do not aggregate amounts across ha, meters, tree counts, or points.

summary.curated_F59_note: All 22 original problem, severity, date, tag_id and coordinates preserved; numeric id (all 1 in source) made unique, old id saved in original_id.
summary.mockup_note: Synthetic scenario, not actual operational field findings.
summary.region_definition: Southern 30% of each block's north-south latitude extent, with polygon intersection overlay; not necessarily exactly 30% of polygon area.

metadata.action_plan_note: All action plan statuses / IDs / progress are SIMULATED; no source workflow data available.
metadata.f59_note: 22 curated F-59 issue/severity/date/tag_id/coordinates preserved; units inferred for mockup, action statuses simulated.
metadata.category_note: 16 canonical classes in properties.problem_category_id / problem_category. Original problem labels retained for existing rows; UI MUST use canonical ID.
metadata.map_status_rule: red if any unplanned tag; else yellow if any in progress; else green if all closed; gray if no tags in active filter.
metadata.map_share_rule: For a single selected category, block volume / total volume of the same category across currently filtered estate/divisi/blok/period, times 100. Never combine different units or make shares viewport-dependent.
